source: Three Hundred Important Combinations — B. V. Raman
source_ne: थ्री हन्ड्रेड इम्पोर्टेन्ट कम्बिनेसन्स — बी. भी. रमन
note: Combinations 50–63 and 68–69 are not detailed in the source excerpt; grouped ranges (e.g. 33-44, 75-106) are stored as a single row exactly as given. Combinations 163-300 (Part II) added from the same source.

combinations.name: Gajakesari
combinations.definition: Jupiter in a kendra from the Moon.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्रमाबाट केन्द्रमा बृहस्पति।
combinations.result: Polite, generous, lasting reputation.

combinations.name: Sunapha
combinations.definition: Planets (excluding the Sun) in the 2nd house from the Moon.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्रमाबाट दोस्रो भावमा ग्रह (सूर्यबाहेक)।
combinations.result: Self-earned property, kingly, wealthy.

combinations.name: Anapha
combinations.definition: Planets (excluding the Sun) in the 12th house from the Moon.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्रमाबाट बाह्रौं भावमा ग्रह (सूर्यबाहेक)।
combinations.result: Majestic appearance, generous, self-respect.

combinations.name: Dhurdhura
combinations.definition: Planets on both sides of the Moon (2nd and 12th houses).
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्रमाको दुवैतर्फ (२ र १२ भाव) ग्रह।
combinations.result: Bountiful, blessed with wealth and conveyances.

combinations.name: Kemadruma
combinations.definition: No planets on either side of the Moon.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्रमाको कुनै पनि छेउमा ग्रह छैन।
combinations.result: Sorrowful, poor, rogue; cancelled if planets in kendras.
combinations.result_ne: दुःखी, निर्धन, धूर्त; केन्द्रमा ग्रह भए भंग हुन्छ।

combinations.name: Chandra Mangala
combinations.definition: Mars conjoins the Moon.
combinations.definition_ne: मंगल चन्द्रमासँग युति।
combinations.result: Earnings through unscrupulous means, harsh to mother.

combinations.name: Adhi
combinations.definition: Benefics in the 6th, 7th, and 8th houses from the Moon.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्रमाबाट ६, ७, ८ भावमा शुभग्रह।
combinations.result: Enjoyable life, healthy, long-lived.

combinations.name: Chatussagara
combinations.definition: All four kendras occupied by planets.
combinations.definition_ne: चारै केन्द्रमा ग्रह विराजमान।
combinations.result: Earn good reputation, prosperous life.

combinations.name: Vasumati
combinations.definition: Benefics in the upachayas (3, 6, 10, 11) from Lagna or Moon.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्न वा चन्द्रमाबाट उपचय (३,६,१०,११) मा शुभग्रह।
combinations.result: Command plenty of wealth.

combinations.name: Rajalakshana
combinations.definition: Jupiter, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon in kendras.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति, शुक्र, बुध र चन्द्रमा केन्द्रमा।
combinations.result: Possess attractive appearance and high qualities.

combinations.name: Vanchanachora Bheeti
combinations.definition: Lagna occupied by malefic with Gulika in a trine; or Lagna lord with Rahu/Sani.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नमा पापग्रह र गुलिक त्रिकोणमा; वा लग्नेश राहु/शनिसँग।
combinations.result: Afraid of being cheated, swindled, and robbed.

combinations.name: Sakata
combinations.definition: Moon in the 6th, 8th, or 12th from Jupiter.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पतिबाट चन्द्रमा ६, ८ वा १२ भावमा।
combinations.result: Loses fortune (may regain it), insignificant.

combinations.name: Amala
combinations.definition: Benefic in the 10th from the Lagna or Moon.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्न वा चन्द्रमाबाट दशौं भावमा शुभग्रह।
combinations.result: Lasting fame, spotless character, prosperous.

combinations.name: Parvata
combinations.definition: Benefics in kendras, 6/8 houses empty or benefic-occupied.
combinations.definition_ne: केन्द्रमा शुभग्रह, ६/८ भाव रिक्त वा शुभग्रहयुक्त।
combinations.result: Wealthy, head of town or village.

combinations.name: Kahala
combinations.definition: 4th and 9th lords in mutual kendras; Lagna lord strong.
combinations.definition_ne: ४ र ९ का स्वामी परस्पर केन्द्रमा; लग्नेश बलियो।
combinations.result: Stubborn, daring, leader of a small army.

combinations.name: Vesi
combinations.definition: Planets (except Moon) in the 2nd from the Sun.
combinations.definition_ne: सूर्यबाट दोस्रो भावमा ग्रह (चन्द्रबाहेक)।
combinations.result: Fortunate, happy, virtuous, famous.

combinations.name: Vasi
combinations.definition: Planets (except Moon) in the 12th from the Sun.
combinations.definition_ne: सूर्यबाट बाह्रौं भावमा ग्रह (चन्द्रबाहेक)।
combinations.result: Happy, prosperous, liberal.

combinations.name: Obhayachari
combinations.definition: Planets (except Moon) on both sides of the Sun.
combinations.definition_ne: सूर्यको दुवैतर्फ ग्रह (चन्द्रबाहेक)।
combinations.result: Eloquent speaker, well-proportioned limbs.

combinations.name: Hamsa
combinations.definition: Jupiter in own/exaltation sign in a kendra.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति स्वराशि/उच्चमा केन्द्रमा।
combinations.result: Handsome body, righteous, pure mind.

combinations.name: Malavya
combinations.definition: Venus in own/exaltation sign in a kendra.
combinations.definition_ne: शुक्र स्वराशि/उच्चमा केन्द्रमा।
combinations.result: Strong-minded, wealthy, command vehicles.

combinations.name: Sasa
combinations.definition: Saturn in own/exaltation sign in a kendra.
combinations.definition_ne: शनि स्वराशि/उच्चमा केन्द्रमा।
combinations.result: Head of village/town, commands many servants.

combinations.name: Ruchaka
combinations.definition: Mars in own/exaltation sign in a kendra.
combinations.definition_ne: मंगल स्वराशि/उच्चमा केन्द्रमा।
combinations.result: Strong physique, famous, leader of an army.

combinations.name: Bhadra
combinations.definition: Mercury in own/exaltation sign in a kendra.
combinations.definition_ne: बुध स्वराशि/उच्चमा केन्द्रमा।
combinations.result: Taciturn, lion's face, lives to old age.

combinations.name: Budhaditya
combinations.definition: Mercury combines with the Sun.
combinations.definition_ne: बुध सूर्यसँग युति।
combinations.result: Highly intelligent, skillful, happy.

combinations.name: Mahabhagya
combinations.definition: Sun/Moon/Lagna in specific signs (odd for men, even for women).
combinations.definition_ne: सूर्य/चन्द्र/लग्न निश्चित राशिमा (पुरुषलाई विषम, स्त्रीलाई सम)।
combinations.result: Liberal, famous, long-lived.

combinations.name: Pushkala
combinations.definition: Moon lord conjoins Lagna lord in kendra/friend sign aspecting Lagna.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्रराशिको स्वामी लग्नेशसँग केन्द्र/मित्रराशिमा लग्नलाई दृष्टि।
combinations.result: Wealthy, sweet speech, honored by kings.

combinations.name: Lakshmi
combinations.definition: Lagna lord powerful and 9th lord in own/exaltation in kendra/trikona.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश बलियो र नवमेश स्वराशि/उच्चमा केन्द्र/त्रिकोणमा।
combinations.result: Noble, man of high integrity and reputation.
combinations.result_ne: कुलीन, उच्च सत्यनिष्ठा र प्रतिष्ठाको मानिस।

combinations.name: Gauri
combinations.definition: 10th lord's Navamsa lord in exaltation in 10th with Lagna lord.
combinations.definition_ne: दशमेशको नवांशेश उच्चमा दशौं भावमा लग्नेशसँग।
combinations.result: Respectable family, virtuous, praised by all.

combinations.name: Bharathi
combinations.definition: Navamsa lords of 2, 5, 11 lords are exalted with 9th lord.
combinations.definition_ne: २, ५, ११ का स्वामीका नवांशेश उच्च र नवमेशसँग।
combinations.result: World famous, reputable scholar, religious.

combinations.name: Kusuma
combinations.definition: Jupiter in Lagna, Moon in 7th, Sun in 2nd.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नमा बृहस्पति, ७ मा चन्द्र, २ मा सूर्य।
combinations.result: King or equal, helps others.
combinations.result_ne: राजा वा समान, अरूलाई सहयोग गर्ने।

combinations.name: Chapa
combinations.definition: Lagna lord exalted, 4th and 10th lords interchanged.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश उच्च, ४ र १० का स्वामी अदलबदल।
combinations.result: Grace a King's Council, wealthy, strength.

combinations.name: Sreenatha
combinations.definition: Exalted 7th lord in 10th, 10th lord in 9th.
combinations.definition_ne: उच्च सप्तमेश दशौं भावमा, दशमेश नवौंमा।
combinations.result: Agreeable speaker, good wife and children.
combinations.result_ne: मनोरम वक्ता, राम्रो पत्नी र सन्तान।

combinations.name: Malika Yogas
combinations.definition: Planets in seven contiguous houses from a specific house.
combinations.definition_ne: निश्चित भावबाट सात लगातार भावमा ग्रह।
combinations.result: Result varies by house (e.g., Lagna Malika: King).
combinations.result_ne: भावअनुसार फल फरक (जस्तै लग्न मालिका: राजा)।

combinations.name: Sankha
combinations.definition: 5th and 6th lords in mutual kendras, Lagna lord powerful.
combinations.definition_ne: ५ र ६ का स्वामी परस्पर केन्द्रमा, लग्नेश बलियो।
combinations.result: Learned in sciences, blessed with family.

combinations.name: Bheri
combinations.definition: Lagna lord, Jupiter, and Moon in mutual kendras; 9th lord strong.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश, बृहस्पति र चन्द्रमा परस्पर केन्द्रमा; नवमेश बलियो।
combinations.result: Long-lived, free from disease, happy life.

combinations.name: Matsya
combinations.definition: Specific malefic/benefic distribution in Lagna, 9th, 5th, 4th/8th.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्न, ९, ५, ४/८ मा निश्चित पाप/शुभ ग्रह वितरण।
combinations.result: Clever prophet, ocean of kindness.

combinations.name: Mridanga
combinations.definition: Navamsa lord of exalted planet in trine/quadrant with own/exaltation sign.
combinations.definition_ne: उच्च ग्रहको नवांशेश स्वराशि/उच्चसहित त्रिकोण/केन्द्रमा।
combinations.result: Respected by rulers, famous, attractive.

combinations.name: Parijata
combinations.definition: Sign/Navamsa lord of Lagna lord in kendra/trikona/own/exaltation.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेशको राशि/नवांशेश केन्द्र/त्रिकोण/स्व/उच्चमा।
combinations.result: Ruler of a vast empire, powerful.

combinations.name: Vishnu
combinations.definition: 9, 10 lords and Navamsa lord of 9 in kendra/trikona/exaltation.
combinations.definition_ne: ९, १० का स्वामी र नवमेशको नवांशेश केन्द्र/त्रिकोण/उच्चमा।
combinations.result: Enjoys luxurious foods, long-lived, charitable.

combinations.name: Brahma
combinations.definition: Jupiter/Venus and Mercury in specific kendras from 9, 11, and Lagna.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति/शुक्र र बुध ९, ११ र लग्नबाट निश्चित केन्द्रमा।
combinations.result: Enjoy luxurious foods, long-lived.

combinations.name: Indra
combinations.definition: Lords of 5 and 11 interchange; Moon in 5th.
combinations.definition_ne: ५ र ११ का स्वामी अदलबदल; चन्द्रमा ५ मा।
combinations.result: Highly courageous, lasting fame.

combinations.name: Ravi
combinations.definition: Sun joins 10th, 10th lord in 3rd with Saturn.
combinations.definition_ne: सूर्य दशौंमा, दशमेश शनिसँग तेस्रोमा।
combinations.result: Respected by rulers, famous after 15th year.

combinations.name: Gola
combinations.definition: Full Moon in 9th with Jupiter/Venus; Mercury joins Navamsa Lagna.
combinations.definition_ne: पूर्ण चन्द्रमा ९ मा बृहस्पति/शुक्रसँग; बुध नवांश लग्नमा।
combinations.result: Polite, head of village, long-lived.

combinations.name: Thrilochana
combinations.definition: Sun, Moon, and Mars in mutual trines.
combinations.definition_ne: सूर्य, चन्द्र र मंगल परस्पर त्रिकोणमा।
combinations.result: Great wealth, terror to enemies, long-lived.
combinations.result_ne: ठूलो धन, शत्रुका लागि त्रास, दीर्घायु।

combinations.name: Samudra
combinations.definition: Planets in 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 houses.
combinations.result: Be a king or an equal.

combinations.name: Jaya
combinations.definition: 6th lord debilitated, 10th lord exalted.
combinations.definition_ne: षष्ठेश नीच, दशमेश उच्च।
combinations.result: Successful and long-lived.

combinations.name: Kulavardhana
combinations.definition: All planets in 5th from Lagna, Sun, and Moon.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्न, सूर्य र चन्द्रमाबाट पाँचौंमा सबै ग्रह।
combinations.result: Unbroken line of successors, wealthy.

combinations.name: Nabhasa Yogas
combinations.definition: Complex planetary patterns (e.g., Yupa, Ishu, Sakti, Rajju).
combinations.definition_ne: जटिल ग्रहयोग (जस्तै यूप, इषु, शक्ति, रज्जु)।
combinations.result: Vary: Yupa (liberal), Ishu (successful), Sakti (lazy).

combinations.name: Duryoga
combinations.definition: 10th lord in the 6th, 8th, or 12th.
combinations.definition_ne: दशमेश ६, ८ वा १२ भावमा।
combinations.result: Derive no fruit from own labor, insignificant.

combinations.name: Daridra
combinations.definition: 11th lord in the 6th, 8th, or 12th.
combinations.definition_ne: एकादशेश ६, ८ वा १२ भावमा।
combinations.result: Contract huge debts, poor, suffer auditory trouble.

combinations.name: Harsha / Sarala / Vimala
combinations.definition: 6, 8, or 12 lords in 6th, 8th, or 12th houses.
combinations.result: Harsha (fortunate), Sarala (long-lived), Vimala (independent).

combinations.name: Sareera Soukhya
combinations.definition: Lagna lord, Jupiter, or Venus in a quadrant.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश, बृहस्पति वा शुक्र केन्द्रमा।
combinations.result: Endowed with long life, wealth, political favor.

combinations.name: Dehapushti
combinations.definition: Lagna lord in movable sign aspected by a benefic.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश चर राशिमा शुभग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Well-developed body, rich, enjoy life.

combinations.name: Dehakashta
combinations.definition: Lagna lord with a malefic or in the 8th house.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश पापग्रहसँग वा आठौं भावमा।
combinations.result: Devoid of bodily comforts.

combinations.name: Rogagrastha
combinations.definition: Lagna lord with 6/8/12 lord; or weak lord in quadrant/trine.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश ६/८/१२ का स्वामीसँग; वा दुर्बल स्वामी केन्द्र/त्रिकोणमा।
combinations.result: Suffer from diseases, weak constitution.

combinations.name: Krisanga
combinations.definition: Lagna lord in dry sign or malefics join dry Navamsa Lagna.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश शुष्क राशिमा वा पापग्रह शुष्क नवांश लग्नमा।
combinations.result: Emaciated body, suffer from bodily pains.

combinations.name: Dehasthoulya
combinations.definition: Varying Lagna lord/Navamsa/Jupiter placements in watery signs.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश/नवांश/बृहस्पतिको जल राशिमा विविध स्थिति।
combinations.result: Possess a corpulent (stout) body.

combinations.name: Sada Sanchara
combinations.definition: Lagna lord or lord of sign with Lagna lord in movable sign.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश वा लग्नेशसहित राशिको स्वामी चर राशिमा।
combinations.result: Be a wanderer, travel agent, or diplomat.

combinations.name: Dhana Yogas
combinations.definition: Various 2nd and 5th house lord combinations.
combinations.definition_ne: २ र ५ भावका स्वामीका विविध संयोग।
combinations.result: Acquire immense wealth.

combinations.name: Bahudravyarjana
combinations.definition: Lagna lord in 2nd, 2nd lord in 11th, 11th lord in Lagna.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश २ मा, द्वितीयेश ११ मा, एकादशेश लग्नमा।
combinations.result: Earn lot of money, amass good fortune.

combinations.name: Swaveeryaddhana
combinations.definition: Lagna lord powerful in kendra with Jupiter; 2nd lord in Vaiseshikamsa.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश बृहस्पतिसँग केन्द्रमा बलियो; द्वितीयेश वैशेषिकांशमा।
combinations.result: Earn money by own efforts and exertions.

combinations.name: Madhya Dhana
combinations.definition: 2nd lord with Kalabala joins Lagna/11th lords in quadrant/trine.
combinations.definition_ne: कालबलयुक्त द्वितीयेश लग्न/एकादशेशसँग केन्द्र/त्रिकोणमा।
combinations.result: Acquire money by self-effort in middle life.

combinations.name: Antya Dhana
combinations.definition: 2nd and 1st lords sign lord with natural benefic in Lagna.
combinations.definition_ne: २ र १ का स्वामीको राशिस्वामी शुभग्रहसँग लग्नमा।
combinations.result: Acquire finance towards the last part of life.

combinations.name: Balya Dhana
combinations.definition: 2nd and 10th lords in kendra aspected by Navamsa lord of Lagna.
combinations.definition_ne: २ र १० का स्वामी केन्द्रमा लग्नको नवांशेशको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Acquire immense riches in early part of life.

combinations.name: Bhratru Dhana
combinations.definition: Lagna/2nd lords join 3rd with benefics; or 3rd lord in 2nd with Jupiter.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्न/द्वितीयेश शुभग्रहसँग तेस्रोमा; वा तृतीयेश बृहस्पतिसँग २ मा।
combinations.result: Get money through brothers and relatives.

combinations.name: Matru Dhana
combinations.definition: 2nd lord joins 4th lord or is aspected by it.
combinations.definition_ne: द्वितीयेश चतुर्थेशसँग वा त्यसको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Earns money with help of one's mother.

combinations.name: Putra Dhana
combinations.definition: Strong 2nd lord with 5th lord/Jupiter; Lagna lord in Vaiseshikamsa.
combinations.definition_ne: बलियो द्वितीयेश पञ्चमेश/बृहस्पतिसँग; लग्नेश वैशेषिकांशमा।
combinations.result: Gets wealth through his sons.

combinations.name: Satru Dhana
combinations.definition: Strong 2nd lord with 6th lord/Mars; Lagna lord in Vaiseshikamsa.
combinations.definition_ne: बलियो द्वितीयेश षष्ठेश/मंगलसँग; लग्नेश वैशेषिकांशमा।
combinations.result: Earns money through his enemies.

combinations.name: Kalatra Dhana
combinations.definition: Strong 2nd lord with 7th lord/Venus; Lagna lord powerful.
combinations.definition_ne: बलियो द्वितीयेश सप्तमेश/शुक्रसँग; लग्नेश बलियो।
combinations.result: Subject will earn money through wife.

combinations.name: Amaranantha
combinations.definition: Wealth-giving planets in the 2nd house (strong/own/exaltation).
combinations.definition_ne: धनदायक ग्रह दोस्रो भावमा (बलियो/स्व/उच्च)।
combinations.result: Native will enjoy wealth throughout life.

combinations.name: Ayatnadhana
combinations.definition: Lords of the Lagna and the 2nd exchange places.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्न र द्वितीयेश स्थान अदलबदल।
combinations.result: Earns wealth without much effort.

combinations.name: Daridra Yogas
combinations.definition: Inauspicious combinations of 6/8/12 lords and Lagna/2nd lords.
combinations.definition_ne: ६/८/१२ र लग्न/द्वितीयेशका अशुभ संयोग।
combinations.result: Produce dire poverty, financial straits.

combinations.name: Yukthi Vagmi
combinations.definition: 2nd lord with benefic in kendra/trikona/exaltation with Jupiter.
combinations.definition_ne: द्वितीयेश शुभग्रहसँग केन्द्र/त्रिकोण/उच्चमा बृहस्पतिसहित।
combinations.result: Become an eloquent and skilled speaker.

combinations.name: Parihasaka
combinations.definition: Navamsa lord of the Sun joins the 2nd house.
combinations.definition_ne: सूर्यको नवांशेश दोस्रो भावमा।
combinations.result: Become a humorous and witty speaker.

combinations.name: Asatyavadi
combinations.definition: 2nd lord in house of Sani/Mars; malefics in kendra/trikona.
combinations.definition_ne: द्वितीयेश शनि/मंगलको राशिमा; केन्द्र/त्रिकोणमा पापग्रह।
combinations.result: The native will be a liar.

combinations.name: Jada
combinations.definition: 2nd lord in the 10th house with malefics.
combinations.definition_ne: द्वितीयेश दशौं भावमा पापग्रहसँग।
combinations.result: Becomes nervous in public assemblies.

combinations.name: Mooka
combinations.definition: 2nd lord joins the 8th house with Jupiter.
combinations.definition_ne: द्वितीयेश बृहस्पतिसँग आठौं भावमा।
combinations.result: Becomes dumb (unless 8th is Jupiter's own/exaltation sign).
combinations.result_ne: गुँगो हुने (आठौं भाव बृहस्पतिको स्व/उच्च भए यो लागू हुँदैन)।

combinations.name: Netranasa
combinations.definition: 10th and 6th lords join Lagna with the 2nd lord, or are in Neechamsa.
combinations.definition_ne: दशम र षष्ठेश द्वितीयेशसहित लग्नमा, वा नीचांशमा।
combinations.result: Loses eyesight, may become blind.
combinations.result_ne: आँखाको ज्योति गुम्ने, अन्धो हुन सक्ने।

combinations.name: Andha
combinations.definition: Mercury and Moon in the 2nd house, or Lagna/2nd lords join 2nd with the Sun.
combinations.definition_ne: बुध र चन्द्रमा दोस्रो भावमा, वा लग्न/द्वितीयेश सूर्यसँग दोस्रोमा।
combinations.result: Defective night vision or born blind.

combinations.name: Sumukha (I)
combinations.definition: 2nd lord in a kendra aspected by benefics.
combinations.definition_ne: द्वितीयेश शुभग्रहको दृष्टियुक्त केन्द्रमा।
combinations.result: Attractive and smiling face.

combinations.name: Sumukha (II)
combinations.definition: Benefics join the 2nd house.
combinations.definition_ne: शुभग्रह दोस्रो भावमा।
combinations.result: Attractive and smiling face.

combinations.name: Durmukha (I)
combinations.definition: Malefics in the 2nd house; its lord joins an evil planet or is debilitated.
combinations.definition_ne: दोस्रो भावमा पापग्रह; द्वितीयेश अशुभग्रहसँग वा नीचमा।
combinations.result: Ugly face, angry and irritable.
combinations.result_ne: कुरूप अनुहार, रिसाहा र चिडचिडे स्वभाव।

combinations.name: Durmukha (II)
combinations.definition: Evil 2nd lord joins Gulika or unfriendly/debilitated Navamsa with malefics.
combinations.definition_ne: अशुभ द्वितीयेश गुलिकसँग वा नीच/शत्रु नवांशमा पापग्रहसहित।
combinations.result: Ugly face, angry and irritable.
combinations.result_ne: कुरूप अनुहार, रिसाहा र चिडचिडे स्वभाव।

combinations.name: Bhojana Soukhya
combinations.definition: Powerful 2nd lord in Vaiseshikamsa aspected by Jupiter/Venus.
combinations.definition_ne: बलियो द्वितीयेश वैशेषिकांशमा बृहस्पति/शुक्रको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Rich, always good and delicious food.

combinations.name: Annadana
combinations.definition: 2nd lord in Vaiseshikamsa with/aspected by Jupiter and Mercury.
combinations.definition_ne: द्वितीयेश वैशेषिकांशमा बृहस्पति र बुधसँग वा दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Hospitable, feeds many people.

combinations.name: Parannabhojana
combinations.definition: 2nd lord debilitated or in unfriendly Navamsa aspected by a debilitated planet.
combinations.definition_ne: द्वितीयेश नीच वा शत्रु नवांशमा नीच ग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Lives on food given by others, dependent.

combinations.name: Sraddhannabhuktha
combinations.definition: Saturn owns/joins the 2nd lord, or the 2nd is aspected by debilitated Saturn.
combinations.definition_ne: शनि द्वितीयेशको स्वामी वा साथी, वा दोस्रो नीच शनिको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Eats food prepared at death ceremonies (Sraddha).

combinations.name: Sarpaganda (I)
combinations.definition: Rahu joins the 2nd house with Mandi.
combinations.definition_ne: राहु मान्दीसँग दोस्रो भावमा।
combinations.result: Bitten by a snake.

combinations.name: Vakchalana
combinations.definition: Malefic 2nd lord in a cruel Navamsa, devoid of benefic aspect/association.
combinations.definition_ne: पापग्रह द्वितीयेश क्रूर नवांशमा, शुभ दृष्टि/साथविहीन।
combinations.result: Becomes a stammerer.

combinations.name: Vishaprayoga
combinations.definition: 2nd house joined/aspected by malefics; 2nd lord in cruel Navamsa aspected by a malefic.
combinations.definition_ne: दोस्रो भाव पापग्रहले युक्त/दृष्ट; द्वितीयेश क्रूर नवांशमा पापग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Poisoned by others.

combinations.name: Bhratruvriddhi
combinations.definition: 3rd lord/Mars/3rd house joined or aspected by benefics, otherwise strong.
combinations.definition_ne: तृतीयेश/मंगल/तेस्रो भाव शुभग्रहयुक्त वा दृष्ट, अन्यथा बलियो।
combinations.result: Happy through brothers who attain great prosperity.

combinations.name: Sodaranasa
combinations.definition: Mars and 3rd lord in the 8th (or 3rd/5th/7th) aspected by malefics.
combinations.definition_ne: मंगल र तृतीयेश आठौं (वा ३,५,७) भावमा पापग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Loses almost all brothers and sisters.

combinations.name: Ekabhagini
combinations.definition: Mercury/3rd lord/Mars join the 3rd house, the Moon, and Saturn respectively.
combinations.definition_ne: बुध/तृतीयेश/मंगल क्रमशः तेस्रो भाव, चन्द्र र शनिसँग।
combinations.result: Has only one sister.

combinations.name: Dwadasa Sahodara
combinations.definition: 3rd lord in a kendra; exalted Mars joins Jupiter in Capricorn (trine from 3rd lord).
combinations.definition_ne: तृतीयेश केन्द्रमा; उच्च मंगल मकरमा बृहस्पतिसँग (तृतीयेशबाट त्रिकोण)।
combinations.result: Third of twelve brothers and sisters.

combinations.name: Sapthasankhya Sahodara
combinations.definition: 12th lord joins Mars; Moon in 3rd with Jupiter, free of Venus.
combinations.definition_ne: द्वादशेश मंगलसँग; चन्द्र तेस्रोमा बृहस्पतिसँग, शुक्रविहीन।
combinations.result: Has seven brothers.

combinations.name: Parakrama
combinations.definition: 3rd lord in a benefic Navamsa aspected/conjoined by benefics; Mars in benefic signs.
combinations.definition_ne: तृतीयेश शुभ नवांशमा शुभग्रहको दृष्टि/संगत; मंगल शुभ राशिमा।
combinations.result: Possesses much courage.

combinations.name: Yuddha Praveena
combinations.definition: Lord of the navamsa joined by the owner of the 3rd lord's navamsa occupies own vargas.
combinations.definition_ne: तृतीयेशको नवांशस्वामीसँग जोडिने ग्रह आफ्नै वर्गमा।
combinations.result: Capable strategist, expert in warfare.

combinations.name: Yuddhatpoorvadridhachitta
combinations.definition: Exalted 3rd lord joins malefics in movable signs/Navamsas.
combinations.definition_ne: उच्च तृतीयेश चर राशि/नवांशमा पापग्रहसँग।
combinations.result: Courageous before the war begins.

combinations.name: Yuddhatpaschaddrudha
combinations.definition: 3rd lord in a fixed sign/Navamsa/cruel Shashtiamsa; its sign lord debilitated.
combinations.definition_ne: तृतीयेश स्थिर राशि/नवांश/क्रूर षष्ठ्यंशमा; त्यसको राशिस्वामी नीचमा।
combinations.result: Gains courage after the war begins.

combinations.name: Satkathadisravana
combinations.definition: 3rd house a benefic sign aspected by benefics; 3rd lord in a benefic amsa.
combinations.definition_ne: तेस्रो भाव शुभ राशि, शुभग्रहको दृष्टिमा; तृतीयेश शुभ अंशमा।
combinations.result: Loves fine literature and religious discourses.
combinations.result_ne: उत्तम साहित्य र धार्मिक प्रवचनप्रति रुचि।

combinations.name: Uttama Griha
combinations.definition: 4th lord joins benefics in a kendra or trikona.
combinations.definition_ne: चतुर्थेश केन्द्र वा त्रिकोणमा शुभग्रहसँग।
combinations.result: Possesses good houses.

combinations.name: Vichitra Saudha Prakara
combinations.definition: 4th and 10th lords conjoined with Saturn and Mars.
combinations.definition_ne: चतुर्थ र दशमेश शनि र मंगलसँग संयुक्त।
combinations.result: Acquires innumerable mansions.

combinations.name: Ayatna Griha Prapta (I)
combinations.definition: Lagna and 7th lords in Lagna or the 4th, aspected by benefics.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्न र सप्तमेश लग्न वा चौथोमा, शुभग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Acquires house property with little effort.

combinations.name: Ayatna Griha Prapta (II)
combinations.definition: 9th lord in a kendra; 4th lord exalted, in moolathrikona, or own house.
combinations.definition_ne: नवमेश केन्द्रमा; चतुर्थेश उच्च, मूलत्रिकोण वा स्वराशिमा।
combinations.result: Acquires house property with little effort.

combinations.name: Grihanasa (I)
combinations.definition: 4th lord in the 12th aspected by a malefic.
combinations.definition_ne: चतुर्थेश बाह्रौंमा पापग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Loses all house property.

combinations.name: Grihanasa (II)
combinations.definition: Navamsa lord of the 4th lord's navamsa disposed in the 12th.
combinations.definition_ne: चतुर्थेशको नवांशस्वामी बाह्रौंमा।
combinations.result: Loses all house property.

combinations.name: Bandhu Pujya (I)
combinations.definition: Benefic 4th lord aspected by another benefic; Mercury in Lagna.
combinations.definition_ne: शुभ चतुर्थेश अर्को शुभग्रहको दृष्टिमा; बुध लग्नमा।
combinations.result: Respected by relatives and friends.

combinations.name: Bandhu Pujya (II)
combinations.definition: 4th house or lord associated with or aspected by Jupiter.
combinations.definition_ne: चौथो भाव वा चतुर्थेश बृहस्पतिसँग संगत/दृष्टि।
combinations.result: Respected and loved by relatives and friends.
combinations.result_ne: आफन्त र मित्रबाट सम्मान र स्नेह।

combinations.name: Bandhubhisthyaktha
combinations.definition: 4th lord associated with malefics or in evil shashtiamsas/inimical/debilitated signs.
combinations.definition_ne: चतुर्थेश पापग्रहसँग वा अशुभ षष्ठ्यंश/शत्रु/नीच राशिमा।
combinations.result: Deserted by relatives.

combinations.name: Matrudeerghayur (I)
combinations.definition: Benefic in the 4th; 4th lord exalted; Moon strong.
combinations.definition_ne: चौथोमा शुभग्रह; चतुर्थेश उच्च; चन्द्रमा बलियो।
combinations.result: Mother lives long.

combinations.name: Matrudeerghayur (II)
combinations.definition: Navamsa lord of the 4th lord's navamsa strong, in kendra from Lagna and Moon.
combinations.definition_ne: चतुर्थेशको नवांशस्वामी बलियो, लग्न र चन्द्रबाट केन्द्रमा।
combinations.result: Mother lives long.

combinations.name: Matrunasa (I)
combinations.definition: Moon hemmed between, associated with, or aspected by malefics.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्रमा पापग्रहको बीचमा, संगतमा वा दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Mother has a very early death.

combinations.name: Matrunasa (II)
combinations.definition: Owner of the navamsa of the 4th lord's navamsa lord disposed in the 6th/8th/12th.
combinations.definition_ne: चतुर्थेशको नवांशस्वामीको नवांशस्वामी ६/८/१२ मा।
combinations.result: Mother has a very early death.

combinations.name: Matrugami
combinations.definition: Moon/Venus in kendra with/aspected by a malefic; an evil planet in the 4th house.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्र/शुक्र केन्द्रमा पापग्रहसँग/दृष्टिमा; पापग्रह चौथो भावमा।
combinations.result: Guilty of incest with mother/stepmother.
combinations.result_ne: आमा वा सावित आमासँग व्यभिचारको दोष।

combinations.name: Sahodareesangama
combinations.definition: 7th lord and Venus conjoined in the 4th, aspected/associated with malefics or in cruel shashtiamsas.
combinations.definition_ne: सप्तमेश र शुक्र चौथोमा संयुक्त, पापग्रहको संगत/दृष्टि वा क्रूर षष्ठ्यंशमा।
combinations.result: Guilty of intercourse with his own sisters.

combinations.name: Kapata (I)
combinations.definition: 4th house joined by a malefic; 4th lord associated with/aspected by malefics or hemmed between them.
combinations.definition_ne: चौथो भाव पापग्रहयुक्त; चतुर्थेश पापग्रहसँग वा तिनको बीचमा।
combinations.result: Becomes a hypocrite.

combinations.name: Kapata (II)
combinations.definition: 4th house occupied by Saturn, Mars, Rahu, and the malefic 10th lord, aspected by malefics.
combinations.definition_ne: चौथोमा शनि, मंगल, राहु र पापी दशमेश, जो पापग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Becomes a hypocrite.

combinations.name: Kapata (III)
combinations.definition: 4th lord joins Saturn, Mandi, and Rahu, aspected by malefics.
combinations.definition_ne: चतुर्थेश शनि, मान्दी र राहुसँग, पापग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Becomes a hypocrite.

combinations.name: Nishkapata (I)
combinations.definition: 4th house occupied by a benefic, or an exalted/friendly/own-sign planet, or the 4th is a benefic sign.
combinations.definition_ne: चौथो भावमा शुभग्रह, वा स्व/मित्र/उच्च ग्रह, वा चौथो शुभ राशि।
combinations.result: Pure-hearted, hates secrecy and hypocrisy.
combinations.result_ne: स्वच्छ हृदय, गोप्यता र पाखण्ड घृणा गर्ने।

combinations.name: Nishkapata (II)
combinations.definition: Lagna lord joins the 4th with/aspected by a benefic, or occupies Parvata/Uttamamsa vargas.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश चौथोमा शुभग्रहसँग/दृष्टिमा, वा पर्वत/उत्तमांश वर्गमा।
combinations.result: Pure-hearted, hates secrecy and hypocrisy.
combinations.result_ne: स्वच्छ हृदय, गोप्यता र पाखण्ड घृणा गर्ने।

combinations.name: Matru Satrutwa
combinations.definition: Lagna and 4th lords are natural or temporal enemies.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्न र चतुर्थेश स्वाभाविक वा तात्कालिक शत्रु।
combinations.result: Ill-feelings or enmity between mother and son.

combinations.name: Matru Sneha
combinations.definition: Lagna and 4th lords have common lords, or are friends, or aspected by benefics.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्न र चतुर्थेश समान स्वामी, मित्र वा शुभग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Cordial relations between mother and son.

combinations.name: Vahana (I)
combinations.definition: Lagna lord joins the 4th, 11th, or 9th.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश चौथो, एघारौं वा नवौंमा।
combinations.result: Acquires material comforts and conveyances.

combinations.name: Vahana (II)
combinations.definition: 4th lord exalted; lord of the exaltation sign in a kendra or trikona.
combinations.definition_ne: चतुर्थेश उच्च; उच्च राशिको स्वामी केन्द्र वा त्रिकोणमा।
combinations.result: Acquires material comforts and conveyances.

combinations.name: Anapathya
combinations.definition: Jupiter (putrakaraka) and Lagna/7th/5th lords are weak.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति (पुत्रकारक) र लग्न/सप्तम/पञ्चमेश दुर्बल।
combinations.result: Childlessness or loss of children.

combinations.name: Sarpasapa (I)
combinations.definition: Rahu in the 5th aspected by Mars, or the 5th (a Mars sign) occupied by Rahu.
combinations.definition_ne: राहु पाँचौंमा मंगलको दृष्टिमा, वा मंगलको राशि पाँचौंमा राहुले ग्रस्त।
combinations.result: Death of children due to the curse of serpents.

combinations.name: Sarpasapa (II)
combinations.definition: 5th lord in conjunction with Rahu; Saturn in the 5th associated with/aspected by the Moon.
combinations.definition_ne: पञ्चमेश राहुसँग; शनि पाँचौंमा चन्द्रको संगत/दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Death of children due to the curse of serpents.

combinations.name: Sarpasapa (III)
combinations.definition: Jupiter with Mars, Rahu in Lagna, 5th lord in a dusthana (6, 8, 12).
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति मंगलसँग, राहु लग्नमा, पञ्चमेश दुःस्थानमा (६,८,१२)।
combinations.result: Death of children due to the curse of serpents.

combinations.name: Sarpasapa (IV)
combinations.definition: 5th house (a Mars sign) conjoined by Rahu, aspected by/associated with Mercury.
combinations.definition_ne: पाँचौं भाव (मंगलको राशि) राहुले ग्रस्त, बुधको संगत/दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Death of children due to the curse of serpents.

combinations.name: Pitrusapa Sutakshaya
combinations.definition: Sun in the 5th (debilitation sign or Capricorn/Aquarius amsas), hemmed between malefics.
combinations.definition_ne: सूर्य पाँचौंमा (नीच वा मकर/कुम्भ अंशमा), पापग्रहको बीचमा।
combinations.result: Loses issues on account of his father's wrath/curse.

combinations.name: Matrusapa Sutakshaya
combinations.definition: 8th lord in the 5th, 5th lord in the 8th; Moon and 4th lord join the 6th.
combinations.definition_ne: अष्टमेश पाँचौंमा, पञ्चमेश आठौंमा; चन्द्र र चतुर्थेश छैटौंमा।
combinations.result: Loss of children due to the curse of the mother.

combinations.name: Bhratrusapa Sutakshaya
combinations.definition: Lagna and 5th lords join the 8th; 3rd lord combines with Mars and Rahu in the 5th.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्न र पञ्चमेश आठौंमा; तृतीयेश मंगल र राहुसँग पाँचौंमा।
combinations.result: Death of children due to curses from brothers.

combinations.name: Pretasapa
combinations.definition: Sun and Saturn in the 5th, weak Moon in the 7th, Rahu in Lagna, Jupiter in the 12th.
combinations.definition_ne: सूर्य र शनि पाँचौंमा, दुर्बल चन्द्र सातौंमा, राहु लग्नमा, बृहस्पति बाह्रौंमा।
combinations.result: Children die through the curses of departed ancestors.

combinations.name: Bahuputra (I)
combinations.definition: Rahu in the 5th house, in a Navamsa other than Saturn's.
combinations.definition_ne: राहु पाँचौंमा, शनिबाहेकको नवांशमा।
combinations.result: Large number of children.

combinations.name: Bahuputra (II)
combinations.definition: Navamsa lord of a planet associated with the 7th lord is in the 1st, 2nd, or 5th.
combinations.definition_ne: सप्तमेशसँग संगत ग्रहको नवांशस्वामी पहिलो, दोस्रो वा पाँचौंमा।
combinations.result: Large number of children.

combinations.name: Dattaputra (I)
combinations.definition: Mars and Saturn in the 5th; Lagna lord in a Mercury sign, aspected by/with Mercury.
combinations.definition_ne: मंगल र शनि पाँचौंमा; लग्नेश बुधको राशिमा बुधसँग/दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Adopts children.

combinations.name: Dattaputra (II)
combinations.definition: 7th lord in the 11th; 5th lord with a benefic; 5th house has Mars or Saturn.
combinations.definition_ne: सप्तमेश एघारौंमा; पञ्चमेश शुभग्रहसँग; पाँचौंमा मंगल वा शनि।
combinations.result: Adopts children.

combinations.name: Aputra
combinations.definition: 5th lord in a dusthana (6th, 8th, or 12th).
combinations.definition_ne: पञ्चमेश दुःस्थानमा (६, ८ वा १२)।
combinations.result: No issues at all.

combinations.name: Ekaputra
combinations.definition: 5th lord joins a kendra or trikona.
combinations.definition_ne: पञ्चमेश केन्द्र वा त्रिकोणमा।
combinations.result: Only one son.

combinations.name: Satputra
combinations.definition: Jupiter as 5th lord and the Sun favourably placed.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति पञ्चमेश र सूर्य अनुकूल स्थितिमा।
combinations.result: Worthy and dutiful son.

combinations.name: Kalanirdesat Putra (I)
combinations.definition: Jupiter in the 5th; 5th lord joins Venus.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति पाँचौंमा; पञ्चमेश शुक्रसँग।
combinations.result: Begets a son in his 32nd or 33rd year.

combinations.name: Kalanirdesat Putra (II)
combinations.definition: Jupiter in the 9th from Lagna; Venus in the 9th from Jupiter with Lagna lord.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति लग्नबाट नवौंमा; शुक्र बृहस्पतिबाट नवौंमा लग्नेशसँग।
combinations.result: Begets a son in his 40th year.

combinations.name: Kalanirdesat Putranasa (I)
combinations.definition: Rahu in the 5th; 5th lord with a malefic; Jupiter debilitated.
combinations.definition_ne: राहु पाँचौंमा; पञ्चमेश पापग्रहसँग; बृहस्पति नीचमा।
combinations.result: Suffers loss of issues in his 32nd year.

combinations.name: Kalanirdesat Putranasa (II)
combinations.definition: Malefics disposed in the 5th from Jupiter and Lagna.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति र लग्नबाट पाँचौंमा पापग्रह।
combinations.result: Suffers loss of issues in his 40th year.

combinations.name: Buddhimaturya
combinations.definition: Benefic 5th lord aspected by another benefic or occupying a benefic sign.
combinations.definition_ne: शुभ पञ्चमेश अर्को शुभग्रहको दृष्टिमा वा शुभ राशिमा।
combinations.result: Great intelligence and character.

combinations.name: Theevrabuddhi
combinations.definition: Navamsa lord of the 5th lord's navamsa aspected by benefics; 5th lord a benefic.
combinations.definition_ne: पञ्चमेशको नवांशस्वामी शुभग्रहको दृष्टिमा; पञ्चमेश शुभ।
combinations.result: Precociously intelligent (genius).

combinations.name: Buddhi Jada
combinations.definition: Lagna lord conjoined/aspected by evil planets; Saturn in the 5th aspecting Lagna lord.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश पापग्रहसँग संगत/दृष्टिमा; शनि पाँचौंमा लग्नेशलाई दृष्टि दिँदै।
combinations.result: Becomes a dunce (mentally dull).

combinations.name: Thrikalagnana
combinations.definition: Jupiter in Mrudwamsa/own Navamsa or Gopuramsa, aspected by a benefic.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति मृद्वंश/स्वनवांश वा गोपुरांशमा, शुभग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Capable of reading the past, present, and future.
combinations.result_ne: भूत, वर्तमान र भविष्य बुझ्ने क्षमता।

combinations.name: Putra Sukha
combinations.definition: Benefics in the 5th from Lagna, or a strong 5th lord aspected by benefics.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नबाट पाँचौंमा शुभग्रह, वा बलियो पञ्चमेश शुभग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Immense happiness from children.

combinations.name: Jara
combinations.definition: 7th lord in the 4th, in exchange with the 4th lord, aspected by malefics.
combinations.definition_ne: सप्तमेश चौथोमा चतुर्थेशसँग स्थान साटेको, पापग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Has connections with multiple partners.

combinations.name: Jarajaputra
combinations.definition: 5th lord conjoined with Venus; the Moon occupies the 5th house.
combinations.definition_ne: पञ्चमेश शुक्रसँग संयुक्त; चन्द्रमा पाँचौंमा।
combinations.result: Wife gets an issue from another man if the native is impotent.
combinations.result_ne: पति नपुंसक भए पत्नीले अर्काबाट सन्तान पाउने।

combinations.name: Bahu Stree
combinations.definition: 7th lord in own/exaltation sign, conjoined with Venus.
combinations.definition_ne: सप्तमेश स्व वा उच्च राशिमा शुक्रसँग संयुक्त।
combinations.result: Many wives or female associations.

combinations.name: Satkalatra
combinations.definition: 7th lord or Venus joins or is aspected by Jupiter or Mercury.
combinations.definition_ne: सप्तमेश वा शुक्र बृहस्पति वा बुधसँग वा दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Wife will be noble, chaste, and virtuous.

combinations.name: Bhaga Chumbana
combinations.definition: 7th lord in the 4th with Venus, or Lagna lord debilitated in Rasi/Navamsa.
combinations.definition_ne: सप्तमेश चौथोमा शुक्रसँग, वा लग्नेश राशि/नवांशमा नीच।
combinations.result: Indulges in oral/sensual pleasures.
combinations.result_ne: मुख-मैथुन वा कामुक सुखमा लिप्त हुने।

combinations.name: Bhagya
combinations.definition: Strong benefic in Lagna, 3rd, or 5th, aspecting the 9th house.
combinations.definition_ne: बलियो शुभग्रह लग्न, तेस्रो वा पाँचौंमा, नवौंलाई दृष्टि दिँदै।
combinations.result: Extremely fortunate, pleasure-loving, and rich.

combinations.name: Jananatpurvam Pitru Marana
combinations.definition: Sun in 6/8/12; 8th lord in the 9th; 12th lord in Lagna; 6th lord in the 5th.
combinations.definition_ne: सूर्य ६/८/१२ मा; अष्टमेश नवौंमा; द्वादशेश लग्नमा; षष्ठेश पाँचौंमा।
combinations.result: Is a posthumous child (father dies before birth).
combinations.result_ne: बुबाको मृत्युपछि जन्मिने सन्तान (गर्भस्थ छँदै बुबाको मृत्यु)।

combinations.name: Dhatrutwa
combinations.definition: 9th lord exalted, aspected by a benefic; 9th house occupied by a benefic.
combinations.definition_ne: नवमेश उच्च, शुभग्रहको दृष्टिमा; नवौं भावमा शुभग्रह।
combinations.result: Highly charitable and humanitarian.

combinations.name: Apakeerti
combinations.definition: Sun and Saturn in the 10th, in malefic amsas or aspected by malefics.
combinations.definition_ne: सूर्य र शनि दशौंमा, अशुभ अंशमा वा पापग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Bad reputation, setbacks in prestige.

combinations.name: Raja (I)
combinations.definition: Three or more planets in exaltation or own house, occupying kendras.
combinations.definition_ne: तीन वा बढी ग्रह उच्च वा स्वराशिमा केन्द्रमा।
combinations.result: Becomes a famous king or ruler.

combinations.name: Raja (II)
combinations.definition: Debilitated planet free of combustion, or retrograde, in a favourable position.
combinations.definition_ne: नीच तर अस्तंगतरहित वा वक्री ग्रह अनुकूल स्थानमा।
combinations.result: Attains a position equal to that of a ruler.

combinations.name: Raja (III)
combinations.definition: Two, three, or four planets possess Digbala (directional strength).
combinations.definition_ne: दुई देखि चार ग्रहमा दिग्बल हुने।
combinations.result: Becomes a ruler even from an ordinary family.
combinations.result_ne: सामान्य परिवारमा जन्मे पनि शासक बन्ने।

combinations.name: Neechabhanga Raja (I)
combinations.definition: Aquarius Lagna with Venus in it; four planets exalted, free of evil amsas.
combinations.definition_ne: कुम्भ लग्नमा शुक्र; चार ग्रह उच्च, अशुभ अंशरहित।
combinations.result: Becomes a highly powerful ruler or dictator.
combinations.result_ne: अत्यन्त शक्तिशाली शासक वा तानाशाह बन्ने।

combinations.name: Neechabhanga Raja (II)
combinations.definition: Moon in Lagna, Jupiter in the 4th, Venus in the 10th, Saturn exalted or in own house.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नमा चन्द्र, चौथोमा बृहस्पति, दशौंमा शुक्र, शनि उच्च वा स्वराशिमा।
combinations.result: Becomes a ruler or an equal to him.

combinations.name: Neechabhanga Raja (III)
combinations.definition: Lord of the debilitation sign, or the planet exalted there, is in a kendra from the Moon or Lagna.
combinations.definition_ne: नीच राशिको स्वामी वा त्यहाँ उच्च हुने ग्रह चन्द्र वा लग्नबाट केन्द्रमा।
combinations.result: Cancels debilitation, ushering in royal luck from humble beginnings.
combinations.result_ne: नीचत्व भंग हुने, सामान्य परिवारबाट राजयोग।

combinations.name: Raja (IV)
combinations.definition: Moon in the 4th, aspected by Jupiter from the 12th and Mars from the 10th.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्रमा चौथोमा, बाह्रौंबाट बृहस्पति र दशौंबाट मंगलको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Rises to great prominence and power.
combinations.result_ne: उच्च प्रतिष्ठा र शक्ति प्राप्त गर्ने।

combinations.name: Raja (V)
combinations.definition: All planets debilitated in Rasi are exalted in the Navamsa.
combinations.definition_ne: राशिमा नीच सबै ग्रह नवांशमा उच्च।
combinations.result: High political or administrative power and wealth.

combinations.name: Raja (VI)
combinations.definition: Jupiter in Lagna, Mercury in the 10th, and the Lagna lord and Mars in the 10th.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति लग्नमा; बुध दशौंमा; लग्नेश र मंगल दशौंमा।
combinations.result: Earns high authority, wealth, and honors.

combinations.name: Raja (VII)
combinations.definition: Exalted or Moolathrikona Saturn occupies a kendra or trikona aspected by the 10th lord.
combinations.definition_ne: उच्च/मूलत्रिकोण शनि केन्द्र वा त्रिकोणमा दशमेशको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Becomes a ruler or a highly respected leader.
combinations.result_ne: शासक वा अति सम्मानित नेता बन्ने।

combinations.name: Raja (VIII)
combinations.definition: Moon joins Mars in the 2nd or 3rd house, and Rahu occupies the 5th house.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्रमा मंगलसँग दोस्रो वा तेस्रोमा; राहु पाँचौंमा।
combinations.result: Strong career rise, though harmful for children.
combinations.result_ne: करियरमा ठूलो उन्नति, तर सन्तानका लागि हानिकारक।

combinations.name: Raja (IX)
combinations.definition: 10th lord occupies an exalted or friendly navamsa in the 9th, with Uttamamsa vargas.
combinations.definition_ne: दशमेश नवौंमा उच्च/मित्र नवांशमा, उत्तमांश वर्गसहित।
combinations.result: Becomes a ruler or equal to him.

combinations.name: Raja (X)
combinations.definition: Jupiter in the 5th from Lagna, in a kendra from the Moon; fixed Lagna lord in the 10th.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति लग्नबाट पाँचौंमा, चन्द्रबाट केन्द्रमा; स्थिर लग्नेश दशौंमा।
combinations.result: High prosperity, administrative and political power.
combinations.result_ne: उच्च समृद्धि, प्रशासनिक र राजनैतिक शक्ति।

combinations.name: Raja (XI)
combinations.definition: Navamsa lord occupied by the Moon disposed in a quadrant or trine from Lagna or Mercury.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्रको नवांशस्वामी लग्न वा बुधबाट केन्द्र/त्रिकोणमा।
combinations.result: Highly respectable position and general comforts.

combinations.name: Sarpaganda (II)
combinations.definition: Rahu in the 2nd house with Mandi, and the 2nd lord aspected by malefics.
combinations.definition_ne: राहु दोस्रोमा मान्दीसँग; द्वितीयेश पापग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Danger of death or injury from venomous bites.
combinations.result_ne: विषालु डंकबाट मृत्यु वा चोटको खतरा।

combinations.name: Raja (XII)
combinations.definition: Navamsa lord of a debilitated planet's navamsa joins a kendra/trine in a movable Lagna; Lagna lord in a movable sign.
combinations.definition_ne: नीच ग्रहको नवांशस्वामी चर लग्नबाट केन्द्र/त्रिकोणमा; लग्नेश चर राशिमा।
combinations.result: High administrative rise, honor, and prestige.
combinations.result_ne: उच्च प्रशासनिक उन्नति, सम्मान र प्रतिष्ठा।

combinations.name: Raja (XIII)
combinations.definition: Lagna lord joins a debilitated planet; Rahu and Saturn occupy the 10th, aspected by the 9th lord.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश नीच ग्रहसँग; राहु र शनि दशौंमा नवमेशको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Extreme difficulties early on, followed by rise to authority.

combinations.name: Raja (XIV)
combinations.definition: One of the 11th/9th/2nd lords is in a kendra from the Moon, and Jupiter owns the 2nd, 5th, or 11th.
combinations.definition_ne: एकादश/नवम/द्वितीयेशमध्ये एक चन्द्रबाट केन्द्रमा; बृहस्पति द्वितीय, पञ्चम वा एकादशको स्वामी।
combinations.result: Greatness, respect, and high leadership.

combinations.name: Raja (XV)
combinations.definition: Jupiter, Mercury, Venus, or the Moon joins the 9th, free of combustion, aspected/associated with friendly planets.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति, बुध, शुक्र वा चन्द्र नवौंमा अस्तंगतरहित, मित्रग्रहको संगत/दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Becomes a great man or respected ruler.
combinations.result_ne: महान् व्यक्ति वा सम्मानित शासक बन्ने।

combinations.name: Galakarna
combinations.definition: 3rd house occupied by Mandi and Rahu, or Mars in the shashtiamsa of Preta Puriha.
combinations.definition_ne: तेस्रो भावमा मान्दी र राहु, वा प्रेतपुरीहाको षष्ठ्यंशमा मंगल।
combinations.result: Suffers from ear troubles or deafness.

combinations.name: Vrana
combinations.definition: Malefic 6th lord occupies Lagna, the 8th, or 10th.
combinations.definition_ne: पापी षष्ठेश लग्न, आठौं वा दशौंमा।
combinations.result: Suffers from tumors, boils, or cancer.

combinations.name: Sisnavyadhi
combinations.definition: Mercury joins Lagna in association with the lords of the 6th and 8th.
combinations.definition_ne: बुध लग्नमा षष्ठ र अष्टमेशसँग।
combinations.result: Suffers from venereal diseases or sexual organ disorders.

combinations.name: Kalatrashanda
combinations.definition: 7th lord joins the 6th house with Venus.
combinations.definition_ne: सप्तमेश छैटौं भावमा शुक्रसँग।
combinations.result: Wife is frigid or sexually unresponsive.

combinations.name: Kushtaroga (I)
combinations.definition: Lagna lord joins the 4th or 12th in conjunction with Mars and Mercury.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेश चौथो वा बाह्रौंमा मंगल र बुधसँग।
combinations.result: Suffers from leprosy or severe skin disease.

combinations.name: Kushtaroga (II)
combinations.definition: Jupiter occupies the 6th house in association with Saturn and the Moon.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति छैटौंमा शनि र चन्द्रसँग।
combinations.result: Suffers from leprosy or skin disorders.

combinations.name: Kshayaroga
combinations.definition: Rahu in the 6th, Mandi in a kendra from Lagna, and the Lagna lord in the 8th.
combinations.definition_ne: राहु छैटौंमा; मान्दी लग्नबाट केन्द्रमा; लग्नेश आठौंमा।
combinations.result: Suffers from tuberculosis (consumption).

combinations.name: Bandhana
combinations.definition: Lagna and 6th lords join a kendra or trikona with Saturn, Rahu, or Ketu.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्न र षष्ठेश शनि, राहु वा केतुसँग केन्द्र/त्रिकोणमा।
combinations.result: Undergoes incarceration (imprisonment).

combinations.name: Karascheda
combinations.definition: Saturn and Jupiter are in the 9th and 3rd houses.
combinations.definition_ne: शनि र बृहस्पति नवौं र तेस्रो भावमा।
combinations.result: Loss of hands or limbs due to accident or severe injury.

combinations.name: Sirachcheda
combinations.definition: 6th lord conjoined with Venus, while the Sun or Saturn joins Rahu in a cruel shashtiamsa.
combinations.definition_ne: षष्ठेश शुक्रसँग; सूर्य वा शनि राहुसँग क्रूर षष्ठ्यंशमा।
combinations.result: Death by decapitation (hanging or beheading).

combinations.name: Durmarana
combinations.definition: Moon, aspected by the Lagna lord, occupies the 6th, 8th, or 12th with Saturn, Mandi, or Rahu.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्नेशको दृष्टिमा चन्द्रमा ६/८/१२ मा शनि, मान्दी वा राहुसँग।
combinations.result: Meets an unnatural death.

combinations.name: Yuddhe Marana
combinations.definition: Mars (6th or 8th lord) conjoins the 3rd lord and Rahu, Saturn, or Mandi in cruel amsas.
combinations.definition_ne: मंगल (षष्ठ/अष्टमेश) तृतीयेश र राहु/शनि/मान्दीसँग क्रूर अंशमा।
combinations.result: Will be killed in battle.

combinations.name: Sanghataka Marana (I)
combinations.definition: Many evil planets in the 8th, occupying a martian Rasi or Navamsa and joining evil sub-divisions.
combinations.definition_ne: धेरै पापग्रह आठौंमा मंगलको राशि/नवांशमा, अशुभ उपविभागसहित।
combinations.result: Dies collectively with many others (mass casualty).

combinations.name: Sanghataka Marana (II)
combinations.definition: Sun, Rahu, and Saturn, aspected by the 8th lord, join evil amsas.
combinations.definition_ne: सूर्य, राहु र शनि अष्टमेशको दृष्टिमा अशुभ अंशमा।
combinations.result: Dies collectively with many others.

combinations.name: Peenasaroga
combinations.definition: Moon, Saturn, and a malefic in the 6th, 8th, and 12th respectively; Lagna lord in a malefic Navamsa.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्र, शनि र पापग्रह क्रमशः ६,८,१२ मा; लग्नेश अशुभ नवांशमा।
combinations.result: Suffers chronic inflammation of the nasal membrane.

combinations.name: Pittaroga
combinations.definition: 6th house occupied by a malefic; Sun conjoined with a malefic and aspected by another malefic.
combinations.definition_ne: छैटौं भावमा पापग्रह; सूर्य पापग्रहसँग संगत र दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Suffers severe bilious (liver/bile) complaints.

combinations.name: Vikalangapatni
combinations.definition: Venus and the Sun occupy the 7th, 9th, or 5th house.
combinations.definition_ne: शुक्र र सूर्य सातौं, नवौं वा पाँचौंमा।
combinations.result: Wife has deformed or weak limbs.
combinations.result_ne: पत्नीका अंग कमजोर वा विकृत हुने।

combinations.name: Putrakalatraheena
combinations.definition: Waning Moon in the 5th and malefics occupy the 12th, 7th, and Lagna.
combinations.definition_ne: क्षीण चन्द्रमा पाँचौंमा; पापग्रह बाह्रौं, सातौं र लग्नमा।
combinations.result: Deprived of both wife and children.

combinations.name: Bharyasahavyabhichara
combinations.definition: Venus, Saturn, and Mars join the Moon in the 7th house.
combinations.definition_ne: शुक्र, शनि र मंगल चन्द्रसँग सातौंमा।
combinations.result: Both husband and wife guilty of adultery.

combinations.name: Vamsacheda
combinations.definition: 10th, 7th, and 4th houses occupied by the Moon, Venus, and malefics respectively.
combinations.definition_ne: दशौं, सातौं र चौथो भावमा क्रमशः चन्द्र, शुक्र र पापग्रह।
combinations.result: Extinguishes his family line (no descendants).

combinations.name: Guhyaroga
combinations.definition: Moon joins malefics in the Navamsa of Cancer or Scorpio.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्रमा कर्कट वा वृश्चिक नवांशमा पापग्रहसँग।
combinations.result: Suffers diseases of private parts, piles, or hernia.

combinations.name: Angaheena
combinations.definition: Moon in the 10th, Mars in the 7th, and Saturn in the 2nd from the Sun.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्रमा दशौंमा, मंगल सातौंमा, शनि सूर्यबाट दोस्रोमा।
combinations.result: Suffers loss of limbs or paralysis.

combinations.name: Swetakushta
combinations.definition: Mars and Saturn in the 2nd and 12th, the Moon in Lagna, and the Sun in the 7th.
combinations.definition_ne: मंगल र शनि दोस्रो र बाह्रौंमा; चन्द्र लग्नमा; सूर्य सातौंमा।
combinations.result: Suffers from white leprosy (vitiligo).

combinations.name: Pisacha Grastha
combinations.definition: Rahu in Lagna in conjunction with the Moon, and malefics join trines.
combinations.definition_ne: राहु लग्नमा चन्द्रसँग; पापग्रह त्रिकोणमा।
combinations.result: Suffers mental derangement or attacks attributed to 'spirits'.

combinations.name: Andha (I)
combinations.definition: Sun rises in Lagna in conjunction with Rahu, and malefics are disposed in trines.
combinations.definition_ne: सूर्य लग्नमा राहुसँग उदाउने; पापग्रह त्रिकोणमा।
combinations.result: Born stone-blind.

combinations.name: Andha (II)
combinations.definition: Mars, the Moon, Saturn, and the Sun respectively occupy the 2nd, 6th, 12th, and 8th.
combinations.definition_ne: मंगल, चन्द्र, शनि र सूर्य क्रमशः दोस्रो, छैटौं, बाह्रौं र आठौंमा।
combinations.result: Born stone-blind.

combinations.name: Vatharoga
combinations.definition: Jupiter is in Lagna and Saturn is in the 7th house.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति लग्नमा; शनि सातौंमा।
combinations.result: Suffers from windy complaints, gout, or rheumatism.

combinations.name: Matibhramana (I)
combinations.definition: Jupiter and Mars occupy the Lagna and 7th respectively.
combinations.definition_ne: बृहस्पति र मंगल क्रमशः लग्न र सातौंमा।
combinations.result: Becomes insane or mentally deranged.

combinations.name: Matibhramana (II)
combinations.definition: Saturn is in Lagna, and Mars joins the 9th, 5th, or 7th.
combinations.definition_ne: शनि लग्नमा; मंगल नवौं, पाँचौं वा सातौंमा।
combinations.result: Becomes insane.

combinations.name: Matibhramana (III)
combinations.definition: Saturn occupies the 12th house with the waning Moon.
combinations.definition_ne: शनि बाह्रौंमा क्षीण चन्द्रसँग।
combinations.result: Becomes insane.

combinations.name: Matibhramana (IV)
combinations.definition: Moon and Mercury in a kendra, aspected by or conjoined with any other planet.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्र र बुध केन्द्रमा, अन्य कुनै ग्रहको दृष्टि/संगतमा।
combinations.result: Becomes insane.

combinations.name: Khalawata
combinations.definition: Ascendant falls in a malefic sign, aspected by malefics.
combinations.definition_ne: लग्न पापी राशिमा, पापग्रहको दृष्टिमा।
combinations.result: Becomes bald-headed early.

combinations.name: Nishturabhashi
combinations.definition: Moon is in conjunction with Saturn.
combinations.definition_ne: चन्द्रमा शनिसँग संयुक्त।
combinations.result: Harsh, blunt, and offensive in speech.

combinations.name: Rajabhrashta
combinations.definition: Lords of Arudha Lagna and Arudha Dwadasa are in conjunction.
combinations.definition_ne: अरूढ लग्न र अरूढ द्वादशका स्वामी संयुक्त।
combinations.result: Suffers a dramatic fall from high position and power.
combinations.result_ne: उच्च पद र शक्तिबाट नाटकीय पतन।

combinations.name: Raja Yoga Bhanga (I)
combinations.definition: Ascendant is Leo, Saturn is in Libra (exaltation) but occupies a debilitated Navamsa.
combinations.definition_ne: सिंह लग्न; शनि तुलामा उच्च तर नीच नवांशमा।
combinations.result: Born in a royal family but bereft of fortune.

combinations.name: Raja Yoga Bhanga (II)
combinations.definition: Sun occupies the 10th degree of Libra (deep debilitation).
combinations.definition_ne: सूर्य तुला राशिको दशौं अंशमा (गहिरो नीच)।
combinations.result: Destroys potential rise, keeping the native in misery.
combinations.result_ne: सम्भावित उन्नति नष्ट हुने, दुःखमै रहने।

combinations.name: Gohanta
combinations.definition: Malefic devoid of benefic aspect in a kendra, and Jupiter in the 8th house.
combinations.definition_ne: शुभ दृष्टिविहीन पापग्रह केन्द्रमा; बृहस्पति आठौंमा।
combinations.result: Becomes a butcher (or engages in cruel/slaughter trades).
combinations.result_ne: कसाइ वा क्रूर/वध व्यवसायमा संलग्न हुने।
